rationale: Report reseller catalogue: mine once to enumerate commercial publishers covering UA cards/payments; reports themselves are paywalled.
Statista UA digital-payments outlook is on-scope modelled sizing but most values sit behind a paid account.
Deloitte Ukraine publishes recurring free banking-sector overviews and digital-banking benchmarks — durable on-scope producer.
PwC UA survey index is a standing hub of free financial-services research, worth continuous monitoring not one-off mining.
KPMG Ukraine insights hub: free, recurring local FS research and author mapping.
EY Ukraine included for Big Four completeness but no confirmed UA banking/payments statistical output this pass.
NSSMC-authorised UA rating agency with a recurring systemic banking-stability diagnostic — rare non-NBU sector aggregate series.
National rating agency publishing bank-level rating actions with financial commentary; standalone domain despite shared com.ua suffix.
Largest UA voluntary-rating operator; bank/insurer ratings plus analytical commentary, low-cost to monitor.
Quarterly banking-system analytical review series is ideal, but continuity into the war period is unconfirmed — recheck.
Fitch free rating-action commentaries on UA banks give independent asset-quality and operating-environment data points.
Moody's banking outlooks are on-scope but most Ukraine credit opinions require a registered/paid account.
S&P regulatory-disclosure area carries free UA banking sector outlook PDFs with aggregates and named sources.
Info Sapiens runs the NBU/USAID national financial-inclusion and payment-behaviour surveys with free full PDFs — unique demand-side data.
Capable local research holding but no confirmed financial-services or payments syndicated output yet.
Free public report library from a fast-turnaround UA consumer panel; plausible cash-usage and payment-behaviour snapshots.
Generalist agency with only indirect relevance; portfolio pages give weak signal on banking/payments statistics.
Directory of UA research organisations — mine once to complete the local research-house actor map, then archive.
Bank FinScore index over NBU prudential indicators is highly on-scope; URL check failed and depth of free access unclear — recheck liveness.
Open-data aggregator with free financial-sector analytical notes and an API route to registry-derived market data.
Derived bank-level analytics from NBU forms are useful, but URL verification failed and credibility is modest — recheck.
Low-credibility media/analytics hybrid, largely redundant with primary NBU and rating-agency material.
Second reseller catalogue: cross-check against ResearchAndMarkets once to complete the publisher map; reports paywalled.
Free Europe POS/mPOS market-size and segmentation pages are the closest commercial estimate of UA terminal installed base — core A4 ATM/POS topic.
Press-release wire is a strong free discovery feed for UA study headline findings; URL check failed, recheck liveness before approving.
Global Findex is the benchmark public demand-side dataset for UA account ownership, card use and digital payments.
Findex Ukraine microdata catalogue enables custom cuts on card and cash behaviour; free but registration-gated download at file level.
